name: slave
description: a Slave, a thin barefoot man with tanned skin, messy brown hair and a short brown beard: a ragged grey-brown sackcloth tunic, an iron collar and iron wrist shackles joined by a dangling dark iron chain, a heavy tan sack full of grey stones carried on his back over his right shoulder on the screen-left, and a worn wooden pickaxe with a dark iron head held low in his LEFT hand
hands: the pickaxe stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side holds the sack on his shoulder as an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the pickaxe is lifted up over the head with its iron head pointing up and back, the sack of stones on his back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the pickaxe cocked behind the head with its iron head hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in at the sack
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the pickaxe is level, its iron head pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: pickaxe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the pickaxe's iron point striking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance, the chain swinging
strike.5: follow-through: the pickaxe carries on down until its iron head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the messy hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the pickaxe lowers back toward its resting angle, held low at the lower-right

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, the pickaxe arm jerked out to the right with the pickaxe held low)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the pickaxe dipping low, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, pickaxe arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the pickaxe lowering, the heavy sack of stones dragging at his shoulders
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the pickaxe's iron head resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left onto the sack of stones, the pickaxe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the sack of stones under his shoulders; the pickaxe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the chain between his shackles settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the iron collar and shackles still on, the pickaxe on the ground beside him
